title: National Commission's Investigation into Allegations Against the President and Members of a State Commission

content.scenario: A consumer in India files a complaint against the President and members of a State Commission, alleging that they have engaged in unfair practices. The National Commission receives this complaint and decides to investigate it.
content.outcome: The National Commission investigates the allegations and submits an inquiry report to the State Government concerned along with a copy endorsed to the Central Government for necessary action.
